upload.heading: Upload answer sheet
upload.dropzone: Drag and drop a PDF file here, or click to select one

errors.noPdfFile: No PDF file available for annotation.
errors.canvasContext: Could not get a 2D context to rotate this page.
errors.generatePdfFailed: Failed to generate annotated PDF. Please try again.
errors.fullscreenBlocked: Your browser wouldn't allow fullscreen here.
errors.draftSaveFailed: Couldn't save draft. Please try again.

errors.submitFailedNotRescued: {{reason}} Nothing was saved — your marking is still on screen, please try again.

confirmLeave: Changes you made may not be saved. Are you sure you want to leave this page?

toasts.draftSavedDesc: You can safely leave and resume this evaluation later.
toasts.draftRestoredDesc: We loaded your saved progress. Continue where you left off.
toasts.rotateWarning: Existing marks on this page may shift — check their position after rotating.
toasts.evaluationSubmittedDesc: The answer sheet evaluation has been completed and submitted.

toolHelp.select: Select, move or resize any annotation on the page.
toolHelp.pen: Click, then draw free-hand on the page. Adjust colour and thickness from the Stroke control next to it.
toolHelp.tick: Click, then click anywhere on the page to stamp a green tick — click again to stamp more.
toolHelp.cross: Click, then click anywhere on the page to stamp a red cross — click again to stamp more.
toolHelp.text: Click, then click on the page to add a comment box and start typing.
toolHelp.box: Click, then click anywhere on the page to draw a rectangle centred on that spot.
toolHelp.circle: Click, then click anywhere on the page to draw a circle centred on that spot.
toolHelp.delete: Delete the selected annotation(s) (or press Backspace/Delete).

strokeColour.label: Stroke & colour
strokeColour.description: Adjust pen thickness/colour — applies to what's selected too.

marksNumber.label: Marks number
marksNumber.description: Insert a numeric mark (0–9, fractions, decimals).

upload.label: Upload
upload.description: Load an evaluated PDF from your device and continue on it.

reset.label: Reset
reset.description: Clear all annotations from every page.

undo.label: Undo
undo.description: Undo the last change on this page (bottom bar).

redo.label: Redo
redo.description: Redo the last undone change (bottom bar).

pageNavigation.label: Page navigation
pageNavigation.description: Move to the previous or next page (bottom bar).

rotate.label: Rotate
rotate.description: Rotate a sideways or upside-down scan to read it upright (bottom bar).

zoom.label: Zoom
zoom.description: Zoom in, out, or fit the page to the width (bottom bar).

fullscreen.label: Fullscreen
fullscreen.description: Hide the browser chrome for a bigger view of the answer sheet. Esc exits.

submit.label: Submit
submit.description: Submit the evaluation — marks and feedback are required.

resetDialog.title: Reset annotations?
resetDialog.description: This removes all your marks and annotations from every page of this answer sheet. This can't be undone.

submitDialog.title: Confirm Submission
submitDialog.description: Are you sure you want to submit this evaluation? This action cannot be undone.

footer.awardMarksHint: Award marks to submit, or save a draft to finish later.

bottomBar.fullscreenTitleEnter: Fullscreen — more room to read the answer sheet
